source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
If a **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit of yours has an Aura ability affecting friendly **WAR DOG** units, that Aura also affects the **TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS** unit itself while it has at least 2 friendly **WAR DOG** models in its range.

Example: a Knight Desecrator selected to shoot with 2 friendly **WAR DOG** models within 9" of it is affected by its own [Taskmaster](vsdata:ability/chaos-knights.knight-desecrator.taskmaster) ability despite not having the **WAR DOG** keyword itself, so its ranged attacks re-roll [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) of 1.
